Multi-Paradigm SQL Compilation

Translating Relational Division ($R \div S$) into SQL

Because commercial ANSI SQL lacks a native DIVIDE BY keyword, universal quantification requires these 3 canonical compositional paradigms:

Paradigm 1: Correlated Double NOT EXISTS (Universal Quantification via Negation) 
-- Correlated Double NOT EXISTS: "There does NOT exist any course in S that candidate R has NOT taken"
SELECT DISTINCT R1.StudentID, R1.StudentName
FROM CourseEnrollments R1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT S.CourseCode
    FROM MandatoryCoreCS S
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM CourseEnrollments R2
        WHERE R2.StudentID = R1.StudentID
          AND R2.CourseCode = S.CourseCode
    )
);
Mathematical Equivalence: Universal quantification is rewritten using De Morgan's first-order logic law: $\forall y, P(y) \equiv \neg \exists y, \neg P(y)$. Compatible across Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite.
